summary: DigitalOcean Startups (Hatch) gives approved startups 12 months of DigitalOcean credits (amount varies by partner award level), 15 months of free Standard-tier support, and select startups are invited to apply for GPU credit packages. Eligibility: raised $10M or less, company website with matching email domain, registered DigitalOcean team account with a business/company email; AI-native startups are prioritized and service-based businesses are ineligible. Core credits exclude some GPU/dedicated inference products.
claim_steps: Create a registered DigitalOcean team account with a business/company email (not personal).
Apply via digitalocean.com/hatch — directly or through a DigitalOcean Startups partner.
Eligibility: raised ≤$10M, company website + matching email; AI-native prioritized; service businesses ineligible.

social_proof.title: DigitalOcean Startups (Hatch)
social_proof.text: 12 months to scale: Get the cloud infrastructure you need with DigitalOcean credits (amount varies). Select startups will be invited to apply for GPU credit packages. Must have raised $10m or less. Must have a company website, and an email address associated with the company website. Must create a registered DigitalOcean team account with a business/company email.
